decisions.statement: An addon page names one module as the entry point of its bundle.
Which pages name an entry point is read from the index rather than listed here.
An entry point is reached through the module page that slug is filed under.
The reach is the one the Lua compiler takes rather than a second reach.
One program is built for every entry point rather than one for each.
The program reads its bodies through the change rather than from the disk.
A run with no entry point builds no program.

definition: the files an addon's bundle entry point reaches
